name: Input Capture: Keylogging
text: Adversaries may log user keystrokes to obtain credentials or other sensitive input using hooks or polling. Keywords: keylogger, keystroke, on_press, pynput, keyboard listener, key buffer.

name: Clipboard Data
text: Adversaries may collect data stored in the clipboard from users copying information. Keywords: clipboard, pyperclip, paste buffer, clipboard_steal.

name: Screen Capture
text: Adversaries may attempt to take screen captures to gather information. Keywords: screenshot, pyautogui, screen capture, ImageGrab.

name: Video Capture / Webcam
text: Adversaries may capture video from webcams to surveil victims. Keywords: webcam, VideoCapture, camera capture.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
text: Data exfiltrated over the command and control channel, often base64-encoded images. Keywords: exfil, base64 encode, exfiltration, b64encode data.

name: Application Layer Protocol: Web
text: C2 communication over HTTP/HTTPS including custom web endpoints. Keywords: c2, command and control, requests post, /register, /exfil, beacon, poll.

name: Web Service C2
text: C2 via legitimate web services or rendered content. A novel visual channel (QR codes rendered in a browser) is a variant - pixels pass through browser isolation unfiltered. Keywords: qr code, qrcode, QR decoder, visual channel, browser isolation, qr c2.

name: Obfuscation / Base64
text: Encoding or obfuscating payloads, e.g. base64 command blobs. Keywords: base64, b64decode, encoded payload, obfuscation.

name: Boot or Logon Autostart: Registry Run Keys
text: Persistence via Registry Run keys. Keywords: winreg, CurrentVersion Run, SetValueEx, autostart, registry persistence.

name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
text: Persistence via scheduled tasks. Keywords: schtasks, scheduled task, /sc minute, task persistence.

name: Startup Folder Persistence
text: Persistence by placing executables in the user startup folder. Keywords: startup folder, Start Menu Programs Startup, update.exe autostart.

name: Indicator Removal: Clear Windows Event Logs
text: Anti-forensic deletion of event logs. Keywords: wevtutil, clear event logs, anti-forensics, wipe logs.

name: Data Destruction / Self-Deletion
text: Deleting the implant and artifacts to hinder analysis. Keywords: self destruct, self delete, os._exit, del executable, batch delete loop.

name: Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion
text: Detecting VMs, sandboxes, debuggers to evade analysis. Keywords: check vm, vbox, vmware, IsDebuggerPresent, hyper-v, mac prefix.

name: Hide Artifacts: Hidden Files/Processes
text: Concealing execution: hidden windows, no-console flags, headless browsers. Keywords: CREATE_NO_WINDOW, hide console, headless, noconsole, ShowWindow 0.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Python
text: Malicious use of Python interpreters for execution. Keywords: python implant, subprocess, os.system, exec, eval.

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
text: Downloading additional tooling at runtime. Keywords: download, urlopen, wget, DownloadString, Invoke-WebRequest, tool transfer.

name: User Execution: Malicious File
text: Requiring user execution, often paired with a decoy document. Keywords: decoy, invoice pdf, social engineering, os.startfile, lure document.

name: Data from Local System
text: Collecting files and data from the victim system. Keywords: file download, file listing, collect files, data from local system.

name: System Network/Config Discovery
text: Discovering system configuration. Keywords: system info, hostname, process list, whoami, discovery.

name: Remote Services
text: Use of remote services for access. Keywords: remote desktop, ssh, remote services.

name: Masquerading
text: Naming malware to mimic legitimate software. Keywords: svchost.exe, WindowsSecurityUpdate, masquerading, legitimate name.

name: Process Injection
text: Injecting code into other processes. Keywords: process injection, CreateRemoteThread, shellcode.

name: System Information Discovery
text: Gathering OS, hardware, hostname details. Keywords: system_info, uname, platform, discovery.

name: Indicator Removal
text: Removing artifacts such as logs, files, or the implant itself. Keywords: remove traces, clear logs, wipe temp, cleanup.
